Confirm migration or upgrade compatibility proof before merge. ### Merge-risk options **Maintainer options:** 1. **Complete package qualification (recommended)** Finish the acknowledged rebuilt-package validation of the topology follow-up before landing. ### Technical review Best possible solution: Keep one private plugin generation owned by candidate rehearsal, preserving dependency resolution and serving-state immutability through package qualification.
